title: FastTree native bounded progressive alignment
bounded_subset: 2-32 DNA/protein sequences; global affine-gap DP, deterministic UPGMA and profile-profile sum-of-pairs; no FFT or iterative refinement
reference_pipeline: locked MAFFT globalpair/one guide-tree pass, then locked FastTree 2.2.0

verification.numeric_comparison: alignment residue-pair homology plus final-tree normalized splits and branch lengths
scientific_invariants: ungapped output rows equal input sequences
equal alignment widths and no all-gap column
permutation-invariant normalized homology and final-tree splits
